title: Tomato and Goat Cheese Tart
subtitle: on a buttery shortcrust base
description: A shortcrust tart topped with goat cheese rounds, garlic, honey and oregano, then layered with thinly sliced tomatoes of every colour and baked until browned.

steps.text: Process the soft butter and salt in a food processor. Add the egg and process until uniform. Add the flour and process just until a dough forms. Wrap in cling film and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 170°C. Roll the dough into a 26 cm round and line a 22 cm tart tin, including the sides. Prick the base with a fork.

Arrange the goat cheese rounds on the dough, scatter with crushed garlic, honey and oregano leaves, then arrange the tomato slices on top. Season with salt and pepper and bake for about 30 minutes until the tart browns.
Remove from the oven and drizzle with a little olive oil. Garnish with herbs of your choice.
